## Introduction *[[0:14](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mn86PSbdSDI&t=14s)]* Hey, shalom Israel. Most High Christ bless. And today's 15 minutes with the captains class is called the angels that minister to the saints. The angels that minister unto the saints. ## Scriptures Opened **[Hebrews 1:5-8](/bible/hebrews/1#v5)** *[[0:34](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mn86PSbdSDI&t=34s)]* > [5](/bible/hebrews/1#v5) For unto which of the angels said he at any time, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee? And again, I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son? > > [6](/bible/hebrews/1#v6) And again, when he bringeth in the firstbegotten into the world, he saith, And let all the angels of God worship him. > > [7](/bible/hebrews/1#v7) And of the angels he saith, Who maketh his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire. > > [8](/bible/hebrews/1#v8) But unto the Son he saith, Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: a sceptre of righteousness is the sceptre of thy kingdom. - For unto which of the angels said he at any time: So, to which of the angels said the heavenly Father at any time? - Thou art my Son: God never said that to no angels, but the only begotten, which is Jesus the Christ. - this day have I begotten thee: Christ being the only begotten of the Father. - I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son: And in another place he says, I will be to him, to Christ, a Father. - And let all the angels of God worship him: So God the Father created Christ, the only begotten of him. Christ the Messiah, he end up creating all the angels as well as everything else. That's why he's the only begotten of the Father. So now watch, it said, And let all the angels of God worship him. Worship who? Worship Christ. - Who maketh his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire: So when Christ made the angels, he made his angels spirits. And as well he made them a flame of fire. - a sceptre of righteousness is the sceptre of thy kingdom: So now dealing with what it says: he made his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire. That's pretty much the point of the topic where we want to deal with. He made his angels to be ministers in a flaming fire. So, let's get the precept, because here in Hebrews, Paul was quoting precepts as he was getting ready to deal with magnifying the Son and being able to separate him from the angels. What we're going to do is deal with the angels and their job of being ministers. **[Hebrews 1:13-14](/bible/hebrews/1#v13)** *[[2:36](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mn86PSbdSDI&t=156s)]* > [13](/bible/hebrews/1#v13) But to which of the angels said he at any time, Sit on my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool? > > [14](/bible/hebrews/1#v14) Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation? - But to which of the angels said he at any time, Sit on my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool?: Wasn't said to anyone but the Messiah, who came and died and rose in three days and went back up to the Father, and he only died for the nation of Israel. And the enemies is the other nations that went against Israel and went against Christ. By example, Rome. Another example, all the other captivities, like Babylon, Persia-Media, Greece. All these other kingdoms, they are considered the enemies of God for what they've done to his chosen. So now he's sitting at the right hand till God make Christ's enemies his footstool. - Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?: But dealing with the angels: they are ministering spirits sent forth to minister for them that should be heirs of salvation. And when you read Luke 1:68, we already know what salvation is about and who it's for. **[Psalms 37:23](/bible/psalms/37#v23)** *[[3:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mn86PSbdSDI&t=239s)]* > [23](/bible/psalms/37#v23) The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord: and he delighteth in his way. - The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord: So now God has angels that minister unto those that are heirs of salvation. That's only talking about the elect, the ones that humble themselves to God and that do according to his will. Let's find out what good is. **[Romans 7:12](/bible/romans/7#v12)** *[[4:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mn86PSbdSDI&t=264s)]* > [12](/bible/romans/7#v12) Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good. - Wherefore the law is holy: So what are we dealing with? The laws of God. Wherefore the law is holy. - and the commandment holy, and just, and good: The commandments are just and good. So going back to Psalm 37:23, it says, The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord. That means one that uphold the commandments, one that do the laws of God. **[Psalms 37:23-24](/bible/psalms/37#v23)** *[[4:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mn86PSbdSDI&t=291s)]* > [23](/bible/psalms/37#v23) The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord: and he delighteth in his way. > > [24](/bible/psalms/37#v24) Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the Lord upholdeth him with his hand. - Though he fall: So he might stumble and fall. - he shall not be utterly cast down: The Lord is not going to utterly allow that man to be cast down. - for the Lord upholdeth him with his hand **[1 Samuel 2:9](/bible/1-samuel/2#v9)** *[[5:14](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mn86PSbdSDI&t=314s)]* > [9](/bible/1-samuel/2#v9) He will keep the feet of his saints, and the wicked shall be silent in darkness; for by strength shall no man prevail. - He will keep the feet of his saints: He will keep the feet of his saints. This is literally saying the same thing. - and the wicked shall be silent in darkness: But the wicked, the Lord ain't going to be there for them. - for by strength shall no man prevail: No man shall prevail against God when God is on someone's side. But keep in mind this says he will keep the feet of his saints. Who are the saints? **[Psalms 50:3-5](/bible/psalms/50#v3)** *[[5:43](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mn86PSbdSDI&t=343s)]* > [3](/bible/psalms/50#v3) Our God shall come, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him. > > [4](/bible/psalms/50#v4) He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people. > > [5](/bible/psalms/50#v5) Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice. - Our God shall come, and shall not keep silence: Our God will come, and he won't keep silence. - a fire shall devour before him: This is going to be the day of the Lord's judgment and anger, when he make his second coming. - He shall call to the heavens from above: He going to call to the heavens above. That's his mighty angels. - and to the earth: That's the prophets on this earth. - that he may judge his people: And he's going to judge. - Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice: Gather who? Who are his saints? That's God's saints right there. **[Psalms 148:13-14](/bible/psalms/148#v13)** *[[6:36](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mn86PSbdSDI&t=396s)]* > [13](/bible/psalms/148#v13) Let them praise the name of the Lord: for his name alone is excellent; his glory is above the earth and heaven. > > [14](/bible/psalms/148#v14) He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the Lord. - his glory is above the earth and heaven: His glory is above the earth and the heavens. But just in case, if you still putting the pieces of the puzzle together: remember it says he will keep the feet of his saints. - He also exalteth the horn of his people: The power of his people. - the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel: And who is that? Indeed. The children of Israel. - a people near unto him: A people that's near unto him. Praise ye the Lord. **[Psalms 34:7](/bible/psalms/34#v7)** *[[7:22](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mn86PSbdSDI&t=442s)]* > [7](/bible/psalms/34#v7) The angel of the Lord encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them. - The angel of the Lord encampeth round about them that fear him: Now the saints, those that do good, those are the ones where the Lord is going to protect. He's going to lift them back up. He's going to make sure that they enclosed around. Right? This is what this scripture is going to explain. - and delivereth them: And does what? And delivereth them. So there's many different examples as we read the scriptures. Remind you, it's only happened to the Israelites. No other nation. Let's prove it. **[Daniel 6:22](/bible/daniel/6#v22)** *[[7:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mn86PSbdSDI&t=465s)]* > [22](/bible/daniel/6#v22) My God hath sent his angel, and hath shut the lions’ mouths, that they have not hurt me: forasmuch as before him innocency was found in me; and also before thee, O king, have I done no hurt. - My God hath sent his angel: My God, Daniel's God, the God of the Israelites, has sent forth his angel. - and hath shut the lions' mouths, that they have not hurt me: What did he do? He shut the lion's mouth. - forasmuch as before him innocency was found in me: Before God, innocency was found in Daniel. God saw that he was innocent in the sense of him walking after God. - and also before thee, O king, have I done no hurt: Because also too, even before King Nebuchadnezzar, Daniel moved with wisdom. So now dealing with God: remind you how it said he shut the lion's mouth, that he ain't do no harm to Daniel. I want y'all to understand something. When it comes to this earth, God has everything under his dominion. Nothing happens without his sanctification. Meaning, if someone get harmed, guess what? God allowed it. Even in Daniel's situation, God was able to control an animal, a lion, that he didn't bring no harm to him. Watch what it says in Ecclesiasticus. **[Sirach 39:27-31](/bible/sirach/39#v27)** *[[8:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mn86PSbdSDI&t=531s)]* > [27](/bible/sirach/39#v27) All these things are for good to the godly: so to the sinners they are turned into evil. > > [28](/bible/sirach/39#v28) There be spirits that are created for vengeance, which in their fury lay on sore strokes; in the time of destruction they pour out their force, and appease the wrath of him that made them. > > [29](/bible/sirach/39#v29) Fire, and hail, and famine, and death, all these were created for vengeance; > > [30](/bible/sirach/39#v30) Teeth of wild beasts, and scorpions, serpents, and the sword punishing the wicked to destruction. > > [31](/bible/sirach/39#v31) They shall rejoice in his commandment, and they shall be ready upon earth, when need is; and when their time is come, they shall not transgress his word. - All these things are for good to the godly: So to those that do good, that keep the commandments, what we read earlier, these things are good. - so to the sinners they are turned into evil: But then what we about to read: to the sinners these things are turned to evil. - There be spirits that are created for vengeance: Remember we read in Psalms 104:3 and 4, dealing with God makes his angels spirits. So there be spirits that be created for vengeance. - and appease the wrath of him that made them: And appease the wrath of him. Who is the him? That's talking about Christ that made them. - Fire, and hail, and famine, and death: This is elements. - Teeth of wild beasts: Teeth of what? Teeth of wild beasts. So now we understand. Guess what? To the good, like Daniel, that innocency was found in him, guess what? That lion didn't open up his mouth at Daniel, because why? Christ made sure that that wouldn't happen, because this was a servant that belonged to him. So he had his angels protect him in the midst of that. He controlled everything in that environment. - and scorpions, serpents: Serpents. Just like with Paul. - and the sword punishing the wicked to destruction: Punishing the wicked unto destruction. Now watch this, what it says next. - They shall rejoice in his commandment: They shall rejoice at Christ's commandment. Christ give the instructions. They're going to do it. - and they shall be ready upon earth, when need is - and when their time is come, they shall not transgress his word: They're going to listen to what God's word is. If God say move, do this, do that, and the third, guess what? All these different spirits, they're going to do thus saith the Lord. That's why Daniel, he wasn't harmed in that situation. How did Christ do it? By his spirits, by his angels, in which he controlled. **[2 Kings 6:9-18](/bible/2-kings/6#v9)** *[[11:13](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mn86PSbdSDI&t=673s)]* > [9](/bible/2-kings/6#v9) And the man of God sent unto the king of Israel, saying, Beware that thou pass not such a place; for thither the Syrians are come down. > > [10](/bible/2-kings/6#v10) And the king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of, and saved himself there, not once nor twice. > > [11](/bible/2-kings/6#v11) Therefore the heart of the king of Syria was sore troubled for this thing; and he called his servants, and said unto them, Will ye not shew me which of us is for the king of Israel? > > [12](/bible/2-kings/6#v12) And one of his servants said, None, my lord, O king: but Elisha, the prophet that is in Israel, telleth the king of Israel the words that thou speakest in thy bedchamber. > > [13](/bible/2-kings/6#v13) And he said, Go and spy where he is, that I may send and fetch him. And it was told him, saying, Behold, he is in Dothan. > > [14](/bible/2-kings/6#v14) Therefore sent he thither horses, and chariots, and a great host: and they came by night, and compassed the city about. > > [15](/bible/2-kings/6#v15) And when the servant of the man of God was risen early, and gone forth, behold, an host compassed the city both with horses and chariots. And his servant said unto him, Alas, my master! how shall we do? > > [16](/bible/2-kings/6#v16) And he answered, Fear not: for they that be with us are more than they that be with them. > > [17](/bible/2-kings/6#v17) And Elisha prayed, and said, Lord, I pray thee, open his eyes, that he may see. And the Lord opened the eyes of the young man; and he saw: and, behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha. > > [18](/bible/2-kings/6#v18) And when they came down to him, Elisha prayed unto the Lord, and said, Smite this people, I pray thee, with blindness. And he smote them with blindness according to the word of Elisha. - Let's get a little bit of history real quick. Because the same thing, you got an account very similar, but guess what? Elisha was able to bring more enlightenment dealing with things that we necessarily don't comprehend as of yet. - Beware that thou pass not such a place; for thither the Syrians are come down: So Elisha understood that the Syrians was encamped in a location very similar to the direction where that king was going to go. So it says, Don't go to this place, because the king of Syria is there. - and saved himself there, not once nor twice: So he went to a particular location to avoid the Syrian king, not once but twice. - Therefore the heart of the king of Syria was sore troubled for this thing: So you like, Why can't we find these individuals? What's going on? - Will ye not shew me which of us is for the king of Israel?: So he thought to himself, the king of Syria said, Man, there must be somebody in the internal workings, that when we say we're going to go to this place to look for them, they know where we at. Somebody must be giving our information. - telleth the king of Israel the words that thou speakest in thy bedchamber: So the things that you say in secret, somehow the prophet Elisha of the nation of Israel, he's hearing what's being said, and he's telling the king of Israel about these things. - Therefore sent he thither horses, and chariots, and a great host: And what? So he sent horses, chariots, and not a small, but a great host. - and they came by night, and compassed the city about: So the city of Dothan, they came, they compassed about with this great host. - Alas, my master! how shall we do?: So now this servant of Elisha, in his natural, carnal fear, seeing that he's surrounded by all these men, and it's only a few of them in the city: What can we do? - for they that be with us are more than they that be with them: He wasn't talking in a carnal sense. It was only a few of them in that city, and it was a great host by the Syrian king. And he saw that the mountains was full of horses and chariots. Of what? Of fire. Make his ministers a flaming fire. - And he smote them with blindness according to the word of Elisha: So there are certain things that we can't comprehend. Guess what? In the spirit world, God has his angels. And what are they doing? They're ministering unto the servants, the prophets. And our walk, as we teach repentance, as we're serving our God, and as we're doing pertaining to his will, guess what? God is on our side. God has angels that are on our behalf, making sure that our footsteps are being guided. **[Psalms 103:19-21](/bible/psalms/103#v19)** *[[14:56](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mn86PSbdSDI&t=896s)]* > [19](/bible/psalms/103#v19) The Lord hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all. > > [20](/bible/psalms/103#v20) Bless the Lord, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word. > > [21](/bible/psalms/103#v21) Bless ye the Lord, all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure. - The Lord hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all: And God has reigned supreme over this whole entire earth. He controls everything. - Bless ye the Lord, all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his: Ye ministers of his. His angels are his ministers. And it says, Bless ye the Lord, ye angels that excel in strength. Watch this. It says, Bless ye his angels that excel in strength. I want to deal with that strength part. Watch how this is prophecy pertaining to Babylon that was back then, as well as Babylon here, America. **[Isaiah 13:2-3](/bible/isaiah/13#v2)** *[[15:53](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mn86PSbdSDI&t=953s)]* > [2](/bible/isaiah/13#v2) Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain, exalt the voice unto them, shake the hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles. > > [3](/bible/isaiah/13#v3) I have commanded my sanctified ones, I have also called my mighty ones for mine anger, even them that rejoice in my highness. - Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain: That banner is referring to this Bible. God is saying, Lift up this banner upon that high mountain. What's the high mountain? America, that exalts itself. - exalt the voice unto them: Exalt the voice. What is exalt the voice? Let's get it. **[John 17:17](/bible/john/17#v17)** *[[16:31](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mn86PSbdSDI&t=991s)]* > [17](/bible/john/17#v17) Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth. - Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth: We get cleansed through this truth, and we become sanctified. **[Isaiah 13:3](/bible/isaiah/13#v3)** *[[16:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mn86PSbdSDI&t=1005s)]* > [3](/bible/isaiah/13#v3) I have commanded my sanctified ones, I have also called my mighty ones for mine anger, even them that rejoice in my highness. - I have commanded my sanctified ones: That's the children of Israel that have sanctified themselves through the word of God. - I have also called my mighty ones for mine anger: The mighty ones is the ones where God says, Ye angels that excel in strength. That's the mighty ones. - even them that rejoice in my highness: That's right. Saying the exact same thing that Psalms 103 says. It's going to confirm who his mighty ones are. **[2 Thessalonians 1:7](/bible/2-thessalonians/1#v7)** *[[17:22](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mn86PSbdSDI&t=1042s)]* > [7](/bible/2-thessalonians/1#v7) And to you who are troubled rest with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels, - when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels: With his what? With his mighty angels. So now let's get some history real quick to give you some more comprehension behind his angels, and how they spare or save the ones that do right, and the ones that do wrong. His angels are used for judgment. **[Ezekiel 8:1-12](/bible/ezekiel/8#v1)** *[[17:58](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mn86PSbdSDI&t=1078s)]* > [1](/bible/ezekiel/8#v1) And it came to pass in the sixth year, in the sixth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I sat in mine house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, that the hand of the Lord God fell there upon me. > > [2](/bible/ezekiel/8#v2) Then I beheld, and lo a likeness as the appearance of fire: from the appearance of his loins even downward, fire; and from his loins even upward, as the appearance of brightness, as the colour of amber. > > [3](/bible/ezekiel/8#v3) And he put forth the form of an hand, and took me by a lock of mine head; and the spirit lifted me up between the earth and the heaven, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the inner gate that looketh toward the north; where was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provoketh to jealousy. > > [4](/bible/ezekiel/8#v4) And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel was there, according to the vision that I saw in the plain. > > [5](/bible/ezekiel/8#v5) Then said he unto me, Son of man, lift up thine eyes now the way toward the north. So I lifted up mine eyes the way toward the north, and behold northward at the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry. > > [6](/bible/ezekiel/8#v6) He said furthermore unto me, Son of man, seest thou what they do? even the great abominations that the house of Israel committeth here, that I should go far off from my sanctuary? but turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations. > > [7](/bible/ezekiel/8#v7) And he brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold a hole in the wall. > > [8](/bible/ezekiel/8#v8) Then said he unto me, Son of man, dig now in the wall: and when I had digged in the wall, behold a door. > > [9](/bible/ezekiel/8#v9) And he said unto me, Go in, and behold the wicked abominations that they do here. > > [10](/bible/ezekiel/8#v10) So I went in and saw; and behold every form of creeping things, and abominable beasts, and all the idols of the house of Israel, pourtrayed upon the wall round about. > > [11](/bible/ezekiel/8#v11) And there stood before them seventy men of the ancients of the house of Israel, and in the midst of them stood Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan, with every man his censer in his hand; and a thick cloud of incense went up. > > [12](/bible/ezekiel/8#v12) Then said he unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen what the ancients of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in the chambers of his imagery? for they say, The Lord seeth us not; the Lord hath forsaken the earth. - that the hand of the Lord God fell there upon me: Right? Ministers of flaming fire. - And he put forth the form of an hand: So this angel put forth the form of a hand. - and took me by a lock of mine head: And took me by what? By the lock of mine head.
